<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/management/fleet/ulid/{ulid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindByULID handles HTTP requests to retrieve a single fleet by its ULID.
It parses the "ulid" parameter from the request URL, validates it, and calls the fleetService to fetch the fleet.
If the ULID is invalid, it returns a 422 Unprocessable Entity response.
If the fleet is not found, it returns a 404 Not Found response.
On success, it returns the fleet data with a 200 OK response.
